name: [NWI] HubSpot Deal Closed Won -> BC Customer + Sales Order

parameters.content:
## 1. Load the HubSpot deal
Deal, primary company, first contact and line items, with checks before anything is written to BC. The Stop nodes give a plain-English error.

## 2. Business Central customer = HubSpot COMPANY
Company has a BC ID: find + update. No BC ID: create, then write the customer number to the company's business_central_id.

## 3. Sales order
Create order (header + lines), write the number to the deal (bc_order_id), then set the page-only fields.

## 4. Business Central contact = HubSpot CONTACT
Contact has a BC ID: find + update. No BC ID: create under the customer's company contact, then write the contact number to the contact's business_central_record_id. Finally set it as the customer's primary contact. Runs after the order, so a failure here never blocks the order.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: All settings live here: BC tenant/environment (inside bcBase), BC company, default posting group for NEW customers, which HubSpot properties are fetched, country-name map.

assignments.name: companyId
assignments.value: ={{ String((($('Get Deal Company Associations').first().json.results.find((r) => (r.associationTypes || []).some((t) => t.typeId === 5))) || $('Get Deal Company Associations').first().json.results[0] || {}).toObjectId || '') }}

nodes.name: Selected Records
nodes.notes: The deal's PRIMARY company (falls back to the first one) and its first contact. The company becomes the BC customer, the contact becomes a BC contact.

nodes.name: Deal Has Company And Lines
nodes.notes: Needs a company and at least one line item. A contact is optional.

parameters.errorMessage: =Deal {{ $('Get Deal').first().json.id }} needs an associated company (ideally marked Primary) and at least one line item (found {{ $('Get Deal Company Associations').first().json.results.length }} companies, {{ $('Get Deal Line Item Associations').first().json.results.length }} line items)

nodes.name: Stop - Deal Missing Company Or Lines
Company Has Name
nodes.notes: The BC customer name is the company's Company name.

parameters.errorMessage: =HubSpot company {{ $('Selected Records').first().json.companyId }} has no Company name, which becomes the BC customer name

nodes.name: Get Line Items
nodes.notes: Read-only batch call (POST is only the HubSpot batch-read convention), so retry is safe.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ String($('Get Line Items').first().json.results.length === $('Get Deal Line Item Associations').first().json.results.length) }}

={{ String(!$('Get Line Items').first().json.results.some((li) => !String(li.properties.hs_sku || '').trim() || !(Number(li.properties.quantity) > 0) || li.properties.price === null || li.properties.price === '' || !Number.isFinite(Number(li.properties.price)))) }}

nodes.name: Order Lines Valid
nodes.notes: Every line item needs a SKU (= BC item number), quantity above 0 and a unit price. Checked before anything is written to BC.

parameters.errorMessage: =Deal {{ $('Get Deal').first().json.id }} cannot become a sales order. Every line item needs a SKU, a quantity above 0 and a unit price. Problem lines: {{ $('Get Line Items').first().json.results.filter((li) => !String(li.properties.hs_sku || '').trim() || !(Number(li.properties.quantity) > 0) || li.properties.price === null || li.properties.price === '' || !Number.isFinite(Number(li.properties.price))).map((li) => li.properties.name || li.id).join(', ') || 'line count from HubSpot does not match the deal' }}

nodes.name: Company Has BC ID
nodes.notes: true = update the existing BC customer; false = create a new one.

nodes.name: BC Customer Found
nodes.notes: The ID on the HubSpot company must match exactly one BC customer, otherwise stop (no duplicate is created).

parameters.errorMessage: =HubSpot company has business_central_id "{{ $('Get Company').first().json.properties.business_central_id }}" but Business Central returned {{ $json.value.length }} matching customers. Not creating a duplicate - fix the ID in HubSpot.

parameters.jsonBody:

  "Name": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.name,
  "Address": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.address || undefined,
  "City": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.city || undefined,
  "County": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.state || undefined,
  "Post_Code": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.zip || undefined,
  "Country_Region_Code": (/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test($('Get Company').first().json.properties.country || "") ? $('Get Company').first().json.properties.country.toUpperCase() : $('Workflow Config').first().json.countryMap[String($('Get Company').first().json.properties.country || "").toLowerCase()]),
  "Phone_No": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.phone || undefined,
  "E_Mail": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.email || undefined,
  "Invoice_Email": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.invoice_email || undefined,
  "Home_Page": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.website || undefined,
  "Segment": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.segment || undefined,
  "Responsibility_Center": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.responsibility_center || undefined,
  "Location_Code": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.location_code || undefined,
  "ABN": $('Get Company').first().json.properties.abn || undefined
}) }}

nodes.name: Create BC Customer
nodes.notes: Creates via OData Customer_Card (the standard API create fails on the template GST group). Create call: no retry, by design.

nodes.name: Write BC Customer Number To Company
nodes.notes: Written straight after the create so a later failure cannot lose the link.

assignments.name: customerNumber
assignments.value: ={{ $('Create BC Customer').isExecuted ? $('Create BC Customer').first().json.No : $('Update BC Customer').first().json.No }}

nodes.name: Customer Ready
nodes.notes: Both branches (new / existing) meet here with the BC customer number.

nodes.name: Create BC Sales Order
nodes.notes: Single call (header + lines). Purchase order No. is left blank. Blank dates are left out so BC defaults apply. Create call: no retry, by design.

nodes.name: Write BC Order Number To Deal
Order Has Page Fields
nodes.notes: Skipped when the deal has none of the sales-order page properties.

parameters.url: ={{ $('Workflow Config').first().json.bcBase }}/ODataV4/Company('{{ encodeURIComponent($('Workflow Config').first().json.bcCompanyName) }}')/SalesOrder(Document_Type='Order',No='{{ $('Create BC Sales Order').first().json.number }}')

nodes.name: Set Sales Order Page Fields
nodes.notes: Runs after bc_order_id is written, so a failure here cannot cause a duplicate order. Document_Date is listed before Due_Date on purpose: BC recalculates the due date from the document date.

nodes.name: Deal Has A Contact
nodes.notes: No contact on the deal: the customer and order are already done, so just stop here.

nodes.name: Contact Has A Name
nodes.notes: No first/last name on the HubSpot contact: nothing to create in BC.

nodes.name: Prepare Company Contact
nodes.notes: The customer's BC company contact (the new person is created under it) and the person's full name.

parameters.errorMessage: =BC customer {{ $json.customerNumber }} has no company contact, so the BC contact cannot be created

nodes.name: Stop - No Company Contact In BC
Contact Has BC ID
nodes.notes: true = update the existing BC contact; false = create a new one.

nodes.name: BC Contact Found
nodes.notes: The ID on the HubSpot contact must match exactly one BC contact, otherwise stop (no duplicate is created).

parameters.errorMessage: =HubSpot contact has business_central_record_id "{{ $('Get Contact').first().json.properties.business_central_record_id }}" but Business Central returned {{ $json.value.length }} matching contacts. Not creating a duplicate - fix the ID in HubSpot.

nodes.name: Update BC Contact
nodes.notes: Blank HubSpot values are left out so they never wipe what is in BC.

nodes.name: Create BC Contact
nodes.notes: Creates a Person contact under the customer's company contact, which links the two in BC. Create call: no retry, by design.

nodes.name: Write BC Contact Number To Contact
nodes.notes: Written straight after the create so a later failure cannot lose the link.

assignments.name: contactNumber
assignments.value: ={{ $('Create BC Contact').isExecuted ? $('Create BC Contact').first().json.number : $('Find BC Contact').first().json.value[0].number }}

nodes.name: Contact Ready
nodes.notes: New and existing contact meet here with the BC contact number.

nodes.name: Set Primary Contact On Customer
nodes.notes: Sets Primary Contact No. so BC shows the contact as "ERC Primary Contact Name".
